`Query.has_select_fields` was a property computed as `bool(self.select or self.annotation_select_mask or self.extra_select_mask)`. Calling `.alias()` goes through `add_annotation(select=False)`, which materializes `annotation_select_mask` from `None` to `{'book_alias'}` — I verified this with a probe (`annotation_select_mask: {'book_annotate'}`, `has_select_fields: True`). `RelatedIn.get_prep_lookup` (related_lookups.py:93) then saw `has_select_fields == True` and skipped `clear_select_clause()`, leaving all 10 book columns plus the annotation in the sub-select.
